content.playerFantasy: A lone survivor in a decaying, claustrophobic world, haunted by a forgotten past and battling relentless threats.
coreLoop: Enter a dangerous area with limited information, identify the current threat, and search for a route, key item, resource, or safe checkpoint.
Avoid, outplay, or temporarily resist the threat while managing resources and cooperating with nearby players when teamwork is available.
Reach a checkpoint or escape condition, convert survival progress into unlocks or knowledge, and attempt a harder segment with new threat patterns.
content.progressionDirection: The game will gradually introduce new challenges and content, encouraging players to explore and adapt to the evolving threat.
content.visualDirection: A stylized, slightly unsettling aesthetic.  Dark, muted colors, atmospheric lighting, and detailed environmental design.  Emphasis on visual storytelling and creating a sense of dread.  A focus on creating a believable and immersive world.
